document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The  worst  fear  of  the  northern  wayfarer  has  befallen  your 
group—hunger. You do your best to forage for food, but the 
pickings are scant when it comes to filling three bellies.

Make a Survival (Woodland) roll: if you succeed, go to 54; if you 
fail, go to 197.
